jobs.description:
What to Expect

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales for Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products in Germany, with the focus of selling our Powerwall product, a home battery designed to store energy from solar and/or the grid. You will develop, maintain, and grow a productive customer network, such as distributors and 3rd party installers. In addition, you will actively drive business development opportunities in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with working experience in the PV or energy storage industry.  In addition to a strong work ethic and a team-oriented personality, successful team members exhibit creativity, passion, and a drive to pioneer advancements in an ever-evolving technological and market landscape.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany 
- Build and maintain relationships across the organization of partner accounts effectively communicating Tesla's product and feature roadmap. 
- Evaluate new business opportunities with current and new accounts and/or sales channels, identify suitable product offerings, and take ownership of capturing these opportunities 
- Deliver key market insights into the broader business team 
- Provide sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams,  
- Support evaluating market dynamics across sectors (utility, commercial & industrial, residential, etc.) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, etc.)  
- Represent Tesla at sales and marketing events promoting Powerwall 
- Help identify and support implementation of initiatives to maintain or improve partner training, partner installation quality, and to improve Tesla operations and fulfilment and Tesla support 
- Provide user / customer feedback to IT development teams regarding Tesla tools, systems and to Operations regarding processes 

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years of work experience in an account management/channel sales role within the PV, energy storage industry
- Excellent communication and documentation skills 
- Ability to prioritize work and execute many projects and tasks in parallel 
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, as well as grid-tied technologies 
- Fluency in English and German  
- Flexibility to travel

- 5+ years of experience in shaping highly complex software or data driven products as a product manager or owner

jobs.occupation: Materials Engineer, Thermoplastics/Composites (m/w/d) Fixed Term Contract (Qualitätsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

What To ExpectYou will be an integral part of the Materials Engineering organization,
delivering new materials and manufacturing processes that revolutionize Tesla's
products to build a world of amazing abundance. As a Materials Engineer, you
will support the design, validation and implementation of new thermoplastic and
composite materials. Partnering with cross-functional teams, you'll enable
validation, resolve critical issues, and push continuous improvement forward.
This is a 1-year fixed-term contract at Tesla Engineering Germany GmbH and based
in Berlin, Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Develop and prototype new thermoplastic and composite materials and processing strategies to enable future vehicle designs with lower manufacturing costs and improved quality.
- Provide direction to Design Engineers for optimal materials and processes selection by challenging the requirements.
- Generate, interpret, and summarize materials test data using relevant characterization tools (e.g. FTIR, DSC, TGA, DMA, rheometry, mechanical testing, environmental aging) and create links between processing, structure, and properties to inform engineering design decisions.
- Develop or edit specifications and test procedures to define procurement and manufacturing quality standards, including acceptance criteria.
- Support different stakeholders to drive issue resolution.

What You’ll Bring

- Education in Materials Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science or related field.
- 2+ years’ work experience as a materials engineer or related role.
- Understanding of process-structure-property relationships in polymers and their relevant manufacturing processes (e.g., injection molding, compression molding, extrusion, thermoforming). Familiarity with material modeling or simulation tools (e.g. Moldflow, Sigmasoft, LS-Dyna, ANSYS) is a plus.
- Demonstrated hands-on experience in materials characterization and testing with the ability to assess accuracy and limitations is a must. Experience with thermoplastics processing tools (injection molding, thermoforming, etc.) is a plus.
- Ability to effectively handle multiple priorities, organize workload, meet deadlines, and manage time independently.
- Strong communication skills to educate peers, build relationships with suppliers, and support cross-functional collaboration.Please apply with your CV in English.

If you want to make an impact, you are exactly right with us! To strengthen our team at AurumCars GmbH, we are looking for you as a motivated (Junior) Fullstack Developer (m/f/d). We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: Early Years Educator / Pädagogische Fachkraft Kindergarten englischsprachig (m/w/d) (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description:
Early Years Educator / English-speaking Kindergarten Teacher (m/w/d)
Full-time or part-time | Munich Alt-Bogenhausen

Phorms Campus Munich is a bilingual German-English education campus offering educational programmes from Crèche and Kindergarten through Primary School to Secondary School. Our well-located and lovingly maintained city campus in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, close to the English Garden, is home to an international school community where children, families and staff feel welcome, supported and valued.

In our bilingual Kindergarten and Crèche, we encourage children to try out new things, respect themselves and others, develop empathy and curiosity, and grow in confidence and independence. In this way, we build a strong foundation for their future education.

For our Kindergarten and Crèche in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, we are looking for a motivated and qualified Early Years Educator / English-speaking Kindergarten Teacher (all genders) in full-time or part-time.

Your Responsibilities

• Supporting and fostering children in their individual development according to our Early Childhood curriculum
• Creating a warm, safe and stimulating learning environment for children in Crèche and Kindergarten
• Observing, assessing and documenting children’s learning journeys and developmental progress
• Planning and implementing age-appropriate educational activities
• Working closely with parents in a professional and trust-based parent-teacher partnership
• Bringing your own interests, strengths and creative ideas into the daily life of the Kindergarten
• Collaborating respectfully and supportively with colleagues in a bilingual and international team

Your Profile

• Completed qualification or degree in Early Childhood Education, Early Years Education, Childcare, Pedagogy, Social Pedagogy or a comparable field
• Ideally recognised as a qualified early years professional in Bavaria, or willingness to have your qualification checked for recognition
• Professional experience in early childhood education is an advantage
• Excellent English skills at native or near-native level, as you will work as an English-speaking reference person within our bilingual concept
• German language skills are not mandatory at the start
• Willingness and motivation to learn German and develop your language skills over time
• Enjoyment of working with children in Crèche and Kindergarten age groups
• Interest in working in a bilingual and international educational environment
• Team spirit, reliability, responsibility, empathy and motivation
• Valid work permit for Germany, EU citizenship or a residence title allowing employment in Germany

Our Benefits

• Attractive and competitive remuneration package                                                                                                   • Annual special payment of up to €1,500 gross, depending on working hours                                                    • Additional employer benefits, for example public transport pass or Edenred City Card
• Free healthy lunch
• Subsidised EGYM Wellpass membership
• Comprehensive company pension scheme
• Relocation support for work-related moves
• Corporate Benefits Portal
• 34 days of annual leave
• Regular working hours and long-term shift planning for better work-life balance
• Dedicated preparation and planning time, both individually and within the team
• Regular staff meetings during working hours
• Wide range of professional development and training opportunities
• Support in learning German through language courses and everyday practice in an international environment
• Attractively furnished group rooms, children’s kitchen, well-equipped gymnastics room, extensive library and generous outdoor area
• Modern digital equipment, including iPads and smart displays in preschool
• Bilingual teaching teams with up to three qualified pedagogical team members per group
• Support from additional teaching and administrative staff, including music and sports teachers
• Age-oriented groups with dedicated preschool classes
• A warm, international team on a beautiful campus close to the English Garden

Please note

For this position, a relevant early years qualification is required. Applications from international professionals are welcome, provided that a valid work permit for Germany is in place or can be obtained. For qualifications obtained outside Germany, recognition as a qualified early years professional in Bavaria should already be available or be possible to assess.

German language skills are not required at the beginning. However, we are looking for candidates who are motivated to learn German and willing to develop their language skills while working in our international environment.

Would you like to support children in a bilingual, international Kindergarten and bring your English language skills into meaningful early years education? Then we look forward to receiving your application via our website.

Further information can be found at: https://www.phorms.de/en/career/munich/ (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/munich/) .

You will work closely with senior leadership and have a direct impact on transparency, engagement, and successful transformation.

Do you enjoy bringing clarity to complex topics and aligning different stakeholders? Do you want to work closely with senior leaders and make communication a real driver of business success? And are you motivated to build structures that enable effective communication across an organization?

Your Profile

Are you experienced in aligning stakeholders with different perspectives and driving clarity in dynamic environments? And are you ready to take the next step into a role with company-wide communication impact?

- Communication Skills: Strong ability to structure, simplify, and convey complex topics for different target audiences across various formats and channels.
- Advisory & Influencing Skills: Experience working with senior stakeholders, providing guidance, challenging perspectives constructively, and driving communication effectiveness.
- Language & Mindset: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English, combined with a proactive, structured, and impact-oriented working style.

Our Benefits

🎓 Wide range of further training: Internal and external training opportunities, LinkedIn Learning, language courses, talent development programs, conferences and mentoring

❤️ Active health care: Wellpass, health days, family & care support services, discounts at fitness centers, mental health first responder, fresh fruit and drinks for free
